استعطيت (form X)
# اِسْتَعْطَيْتُ (istaʕṭaytu) /is.taʕ.tˤaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَعْطَى (istaʕṭā)
# اِسْتَعْطَيْتَ (istaʕṭayta) /is.taʕ.tˤaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَعْطَى (istaʕṭā)
# اِسْتَعْطَيْتِ (istaʕṭayti) /is.taʕ.tˤaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَعْطَى (istaʕṭā)
# اُسْتُعْطِيتُ (ustuʕṭītu) /us.tuʕ.tˤiː.
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
